text_en: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back the four winds of the earth so that no wind could blow on earth or sea or against any tree.
text_cn: 这事以后，我看见了四位天使，站在大地的四角上，握住地上的四股风，不让风吹向大地、海洋和各种树木。

text_en: I saw another angel ascending from the rising of the sun, having the seal of the living God, and he called with a loud voice to the four angels who had been given power to damage earth and sea,
text_cn: 我又看见了另一位天使，从太阳出升之地上来，拿着永生天主的印，大声向那领了伤害大地和海洋权柄的四位天使呼喊，

text_en: saying, “Do not damage the earth or the sea or the trees, until we have marked the servants of our God with a seal on their foreheads. ”
text_cn: 说：“你们不可伤害大地、海洋和树木，等我们在我们天主的众仆额上，先盖上印。”

text_en: And I heard the number of those who were sealed, one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the people of Israel:
text_cn: 以后，我听见盖了印的数目：在以色列子孙各支派中盖了印的，共有十四万四千。

text_en: From the tribe of Judah twelve thousand sealed, from the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand, from the tribe of Gad twelve thousand,
text_cn: 由犹大支派中盖上印的有一万二千；勒乌本支派一万二千；加得支派一万二千；

text_en: from the tribe of Asher twelve thousand, from the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand, from the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand,
text_cn: 阿协尔支派一万二千；纳斐塔里支派一万二千；默纳协支派一万二千；

text_en: from the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand, from the tribe of Levi twelve thousand, from the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand,
text_cn: 西默盎支派一万二千；肋未支派一万二千；依撒加尔支派一万二千；

text_en: from the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand, from the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand, from the tribe of Benjamin twelve thousand sealed.
text_cn: 则步隆支派一万二千；若瑟支派一万二千；由本雅明支派中盖上印的有一万二千。

text_en: After this I looked, and there was a great multitude that no one could count, from every nation, from all tribes and peoples and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, robed in white, with palm branches in their hands.
text_cn: 在这些事以后，我看见有一大伙群众，没有人能够数清，是来自各邦国、各支派、各民族、各异语的，他们都站在宝座和羔羊面前，身穿白衣，手持棕榈枝，

text_en: They cried out in a loud voice, saying, “Salvation belongs to our God who is seated on the throne, and to the Lamb! ”
text_cn: 大声呼喊说：“救恩来自那坐在宝座上的我们的天主，并来自羔羊！”

text_en: And all the angels stood around the throne and around the elders and the four living creatures, and they fell on their faces before the throne and worshiped God,
text_cn: 于是所有站在宝座、长老和那四个活物周围的天使，在宝座前俯伏于地，朝拜天主，

text_en: singing, “Amen! Blessing and glory and wisdom and thanksgiving and honor and power and might be to our God forever and ever! Amen. ”
text_cn: 说：“阿们。愿赞颂、光荣、智慧、称谢、尊威、权能和勇毅，全归于我们的天主，至于无穷之世。阿们。”

text_en: Then one of the elders addressed me, saying, “Who are these, robed in white, and where have they come from? ”
text_cn: 长老中有一位问我说：“这些穿白衣的人是谁？他们是从哪里来的？”

text_en: I said to him, “Sir, you are the one that knows. ” Then he said to me, “These are they who have come out of the great ordeal; they have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
text_cn: 我回答他说：“我主，你知道。”于是他告诉我说：“这些人是由大灾难中来的，他们曾在羔羊的血中洗净了自己的衣裳，使衣裳雪白，

text_en: For this reason they are before the throne of God, and worship him day and night within his temple, and the one who is seated on the throne will shelter them.
text_cn: 因此，他们得站在天主的宝座前，且在他的殿宇内日夜事奉他；那坐在宝座上的，也必要住在他们中间。

text_en: They will hunger no more, and thirst no more; the sun will not strike them, nor any scorching heat;
text_cn: 他们再也不饿，再也不渴，烈日和任何炎热，再也不损伤他们，

text_en: for the Lamb at the center of the throne will be their shepherd, and he will guide them to springs of the water of life, and God will wipe away every tear from their eyes. ”
text_cn: 因为，那在宝座中间的羔羊要牧放他们，要领他们到生命的水泉那里；天主也要从他们的眼上拭去一切泪痕。”
